title: EFC Meta-Architecture
author: Morten Magnusson
ai_instructions: Start with index.json for the module map. This is a meta-cognitive layer — it documents HOW EFC is developed, not the physics itself. Key subdirectories: cognition/ (7 nested dirs on reasoning patterns), meta-process/ (13 nested dirs on project control), reflection/ (4 nested dirs on evolution tracking), symbiosis/ (runtime integration with Neo4j/Qdrant). Most subdirectories have README.md + index.jsonld + schema.json but NOT index.json or metadata.json at the nested level.
